notes.title: Pretty substantial bugfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a major bug where bouncing around from one "camera zone" to another can completely botch the camera. Fixed some minor bugs, too.



New course soon? Happy Tiring!

notes.title: UI scaling changes
notes.notes:
A quick update. The UI should scale correctly on all resolutions, including 4K, and the default should look the same as it does on my own monitor's paltry FHD resolution. You may have to visit the UI Scaling option (Options > Graphics and Sound > UI Scaling) first for all of this to take effect.

Also, some bugfixes and under-the-hood optimizations.

But let me know if anything broke.

Happy tiring!

notes.title: A Tiresgiving Update!
notes.notes:
A couple new items:


A festive new hat, just in time for Thanksgiving!
Graphical improvements, especially to the tire person himself.
Camera improvements. Zoom out even farther or closer!
Bug fixes.


Happy Tiring!

notes.title: Full version, dusty gears, and gizmos!
notes.notes:
Fresh off the heels of that update, a new level's available in the full version. ...which itself is out of free-to-keep. Still pretty cheap for now, though. But if you've already downloaded it, you've still got it.

From here on, pretty much every option and quality of life update will also be added to the demo version -- the main difference between the demo and the full version will be the levels available. Saved games should additionally automatically transfer between the demo and full version -- seems to work in my own testing.

Levels might be tweaked or reordered during Early Access.

Happy tiring!
